name: validation
system_prompt: Validation is the deterministic final stage of the AI knowledge engine pipeline. It assembles the canonical Session -> Topics -> Items JSON record from the intermediate stage outputs and checks it against the canonical session schema, confidence bounds, and graph invariants. No LLM call is made; this asset exists so every pipeline stage has a versioned, provenance-tracked prompt entry.
user_prompt_template: Assemble and validate the canonical session record from the stage intermediates.
